decisions.reason: Optical spectrum services build directly on the firm's owned fibre and engineering knowledge and match its high-bandwidth strategic direction, so the firm can interpret results and keep improving the product.
The number ordering portal draws on in-house software platforms and regulatory know-how and supports real-time provisioning, though portal functions may be folded into broader self-service tools.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy regulated telephony product in a market that has been shrinking further since 2019, so the firm has little new knowledge to gain from it and its resources are better spent on software-defined services.

Direct voice network connection fits the firm's voice infrastructure and enterprise base, where it has strong absorptive capacity, and it supports the migration to IP and SIP voice, although voice demand is declining.
